requirements.rule: bet amount, call amount, pot and Lifechips always readable before confirmation
legal action never obscured by drawer/safe-area and all-in requires confirmation
disabled spell has on-demand accessible reason; info toggle never moves action row
reduced-motion mode retains tells and state announcements
portrait circle 64px avoids loss of face/identity
portrait integration does not degrade loading or introduce game state timing changes
no horizontal scroll or clipped important text; route top bar can expand

touch.solution: prototype collapsible info header or sticky action rail rather than blindly reducing poker table; compare touch accuracy on device
